53	_RECORD_KEYS = frozenset({"station_id", "timestamp", "temp_c"})
54	_SATELLITE_KEYS = frozenset({"cell_id", "timestamp", "lst_c"})
55	_VENTILATION_KEYS = frozenset(
56	    {"timestamp", "cell_id", "wind_u", "wind_v", "height", "density"}
57	)
58	_ZONES = frozenset({"urban", "rural"})
59	_ITEM_KINDS = frozenset({"building", "impervious", "green", "other"})
60	_COVERAGE_KINDS = frozenset({"impervious", "green", "other"})
61	_QUANT = Decimal("0.001")
62	_QUANT4 = Decimal("0.0001")
63	
64	
65	def _validate_minutes(minutes: object) -> int:
66	    if isinstance(minutes, bool) or not isinstance(minutes, int):
67	        raise ValueError("minutes must be an integer")
68	    if not 1 <= minutes <= 1440 or 1440 % minutes != 0:
69	        raise ValueError("minutes must be an integer in 1..1440 that divides 1440")
70	    return minutes
71	
72	
73	def _validate_min_count(min_count: object) -> int:
74	    if isinstance(min_count, bool) or not isinstance(min_count, int):
75	        raise ValueError("min_count must be an integer")
76	    if min_count < 1:
77	        raise ValueError("min_count must be a positive integer")
78	    return min_count
79	
80	
81	def _validate_min_points(min_points: object) -> int:
82	    if isinstance(min_points, bool) or not isinstance(min_points, int):
83	        raise ValueError("min_points must be an integer")
84	    if min_points < 2:
85	        raise ValueError("min_points must be an integer greater than or equal to 2")
86	    return min_points
87	
88	
89	def _validate_stations(stations: object) -> dict:
90	    if not isinstance(stations, dict):
91	        raise TypeError("stations must be a dict mapping station IDs to 'urban' or 'rural'")
92	    for station_id, zone in stations.items():
93	        if zone not in _ZONES:
94	            raise ValueError(
95	                f"station {station_id!r} must map to 'urban' or 'rural', got {zone!r}"
96	            )
97	    return stations
98	
99	
100	def _validate_cells(cells: object) -> dict:
101	    if not isinstance(cells, dict):
102	        raise TypeError("cells must be a dict mapping station IDs to grid cell IDs")
103	    for station_id, cell_id in cells.items():
104	        if not isinstance(cell_id, str) or not cell_id:
105	            raise ValueError(
106	                f"station {station_id!r} must map to a non-empty grid cell ID "
107	                f"string, got {cell_id!r}"
108	            )
109	    return cells
110	
111	
112	def _check_hashable(value: object, name: str) -> None:
113	    try:
114	        hash(value)
115	    except TypeError:
116	        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be hashable, got {value!r}") from None
117	
118	
119	def _validate_timestamp(timestamp: object) -> int:
120	    if isinstance(timestamp, bool) or not isinstance(timestamp, int):
121	        raise ValueError("timestamp must be an integer")
122	    if timestamp < 0:
123	        raise ValueError("timestamp must be non-negative")
124	    return timestamp
125	
126	
127	def _validate_temperature(temp: object, name: str) -> Decimal:
128	    if isinstance(temp, bool) or not isinstance(temp, (int, float)):
129	        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a number")
130	    if not math.isfinite(temp):
131	        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be finite")
132	    return Decimal(str(temp))
133	
134	
135	def _validate_record(record: object, stations: dict) -> tuple[object, int, Decimal]:
136	    if not isinstance(record, Mapping):
137	        raise ValueError("each record must be a mapping")
138	    if set(record.keys()) != _RECORD_KEYS:
139	        raise ValueError(
140	            "each record must contain exactly the keys "
141	            "'station_id', 'timestamp' and 'temp_c'"
142	        )
143	
144	    station_id = record["station_id"]
145	    _check_hashable(station_id, "station_id")
146	    if station_id not in stations:
147	        raise ValueError(f"unknown station_id: {station_id!r}")
148	
149	    timestamp = _validate_timestamp(record["timestamp"])
150	    temp = _validate_temperature(record["temp_c"], "temp_c")
151	    return station_id, timestamp, temp
152	
153	
154	def _validate_satellite_record(record: object) -> tuple[object, int, Decimal]:
155	    if not isinstance(record, Mapping):
156	        raise ValueError("each satellite record must be a mapping")
157	    if set(record.keys()) != _SATELLITE_KEYS:
158	        raise ValueError(
159	            "each satellite record must contain exactly the keys "
160	            "'cell_id', 'timestamp' and 'lst_c'"
161	        )
162	
163	    cell_id = record["cell_id"]
164	    _check_hashable(cell_id, "cell_id")
165	
166	    timestamp = _validate_timestamp(record["timestamp"])
167	    temp = _validate_temperature(record["lst_c"], "lst_c")
168	    return cell_id, timestamp, temp
169	
170	
171	def _precision_for(temps: list[Decimal]) -> int:
172	    """Precision needed so means and 3-decimal quantization are unaffected by
173	    the default decimal context.
174	
175	    Covers the exact digit span of any sum of ``temps`` (most significant to
176	    least significant digit, plus carry digits from adding ``n`` values), the
177	    3 quantization decimals and guard digits for division.
178	    """
179	    max_adj = 0
180	    min_exp = 0
181	    n = 0
182	    for temp in temps:
183	        n += 1
184	        if not temp.is_zero():
185	            max_adj = max(max_adj, temp.adjusted())
186	            min_exp = min(min_exp, temp.as_tuple().exponent)
187	    span = max_adj - min_exp + 1
188	    return span + 5 * len(str(n)) + 10
189	
190	
191	def _quantize3(value: Decimal) -> float:
192	    result = float(value.quantize(_QUANT, rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN))
193	    return 0.0 if result == 0.0 else result
194	
195	
196	def compute_uhi(
197	    records: list,
198	    stations: dict,
199	    *,
200	    minutes: int = 60,
201	    min_count: int = 2,
202	) -> list[tuple[int, float, float, float]]:
203	    """Compute urban heat island intensity per time bucket.
204	
205	    Records are bucketed by Unix epoch (floor to ``minutes``-sized buckets).
206	    Within each bucket, temperatures are averaged per station first, then
207	    per zone (urban/rural). A bucket is emitted only when both zones have at
208	    least ``min_count`` distinct stations. Returns a list of
209	    ``(timestamp, urban_mean_c, rural_mean_c, uhi_c)`` tuples sorted by
210	    bucket start, with temperatures quantized to 3 decimals (ROUND_HALF_EVEN).
211	
212	    Station IDs must be hashable. Means and quantization are computed under a
213	    local decimal context whose precision is raised to fit the magnitude of
214	    the input temperatures, independent of the default context.
215	    """
216	    if not isinstance(records, list):
217	        raise TypeError("records must be a list")
218	    stations = _validate_stations(stations)
219	    minutes = _validate_minutes(minutes)
220	    min_count = _validate_min_count(min_count)
221	
222	    if not records:
223	        return []
224	
225	    validated = [_validate_record(record, stations) for record in records]
226	
227	    with localcontext() as ctx:
228	        ctx.prec = _precision_for([temp for _, _, temp in validated])
229	        bucket_seconds = minutes * 60
230	        # bucket -> station_id -> [sum, count]
231	        buckets: dict[int, dict[object, list]] = {}
232	        for station_id, timestamp, temp in validated:
233	            bucket = (timestamp // bucket_seconds) * bucket_seconds
234	            station_acc = buckets.setdefault(bucket, {}).setdefault(
235	                station_id, [Decimal(0), 0]
236	            )
237	            station_acc[0] += temp
238	            station_acc[1] += 1
239	
240	        results = []
241	        for bucket in sorted(buckets):
242	            zone_sums: dict[str, Decimal] = {"urban": Decimal(0), "rural": Decimal(0)}
243	            zone_counts: dict[str, int] = {"urban": 0, "rural": 0}
244	            for station_id, (total, count) in buckets[bucket].items():
245	                zone = stations[station_id]
246	                zone_sums[zone] += total / count
247	                zone_counts[zone] += 1
248	            if zone_counts["urban"] < min_count or zone_counts["rural"] < min_count:
249	                continue
250	            urban_mean = zone_sums["urban"] / zone_counts["urban"]
251	            rural_mean = zone_sums["rural"] / zone_counts["rural"]
252	            uhi = urban_mean - rural_mean
253	            results.append(
254	                (bucket, _quantize3(urban_mean), _quantize3(rural_mean), _quantize3(uhi))
255	            )
256	    return results
257	
258	
259	def align_temp(
260	    station: list,
261	    satellite: list,
262	    cells: dict,
263	    *,
264	    minutes: int = 60,
265	    min_count: int = 1,
266	) -> list[tuple[int, str, float, float, float]]:
267	    """Align station and satellite temperatures per time bucket and grid cell.
268	
269	    ``station`` records follow the ``compute_uhi`` three-key contract
270	    (``station_id``/``timestamp``/``temp_c``); ``satellite`` records must
271	    contain exactly ``cell_id``/``timestamp``/``lst_c``. ``cells`` maps each
272	    station ID to a non-empty grid cell ID string.
273	
274	    Both sources are bucketed by Unix epoch (floor to ``minutes``-sized
275	    buckets). Station temperatures are averaged per station first, then per
276	    grid cell; satellite temperatures are averaged per grid cell. A
277	    bucket/cell pair is emitted only when both sources are present and at
278	    least ``min_count`` distinct stations contribute. Returns a list of
279	    ``(timestamp, cell_id, station_c, satellite_c, diff_c)`` tuples sorted by
280	    bucket start then cell ID, where ``diff_c`` is the station mean minus the
281	    satellite mean computed from the unrounded means. Temperatures are
282	    computed as ``Decimal(str(x))`` and quantized to 3 decimals
283	    (ROUND_HALF_EVEN); negative zero is normalized to ``0.0``.
284	    """
285	    if not isinstance(station, list):
286	        raise TypeError("station must be a list")
287	    if not isinstance(satellite, list):
288	        raise TypeError("satellite must be a list")
289	    cells = _validate_cells(cells)
290	    minutes = _validate_minutes(minutes)
291	    min_count = _validate_min_count(min_count)
292	
293	    station_rows = [_validate_record(record, cells) for record in station]
294	    satellite_rows = [_validate_satellite_record(record) for record in satellite]
295	
296	    with localcontext() as ctx:
297	        ctx.prec = _precision_for(
298	            [temp for _, _, temp in station_rows]
299	            + [temp for _, _, temp in satellite_rows]
300	        )
301	        bucket_seconds = minutes * 60
302	        # bucket -> cell_id -> station_id -> [sum, count]
303	        station_buckets: dict[int, dict[object, dict[object, list]]] = {}
304	        for station_id, timestamp, temp in station_rows:
305	            bucket = (timestamp // bucket_seconds) * bucket_seconds
306	            cell_id = cells[station_id]
307	            station_acc = (
308	                station_buckets.setdefault(bucket, {})
309	                .setdefault(cell_id, {})
310	                .setdefault(station_id, [Decimal(0), 0])
311	            )
312	            station_acc[0] += temp
313	            station_acc[1] += 1
314	
315	        # bucket -> cell_id -> [sum, count]
316	        satellite_buckets: dict[int, dict[object, list]] = {}
317	        for cell_id, timestamp, temp in satellite_rows:
318	            bucket = (timestamp // bucket_seconds) * bucket_seconds
319	            cell_acc = satellite_buckets.setdefault(bucket, {}).setdefault(
320	                cell_id, [Decimal(0), 0]
321	            )
322	            cell_acc[0] += temp
323	            cell_acc[1] += 1
324	
325	        results = []
326	        for bucket in sorted(station_buckets):
327	            sat_cells = satellite_buckets.get(bucket)
328	            if not sat_cells:
329	                continue
330	            for cell_id in sorted(station_buckets[bucket]):
331	                if cell_id not in sat_cells:
332	                    continue
333	                per_station = station_buckets[bucket][cell_id]
334	                if len(per_station) < min_count:
335	                    continue
336	                station_sum = Decimal(0)
337	                for total, count in per_station.values():
338	                    station_sum += total / count
339	                station_mean = station_sum / len(per_station)
340	                sat_total, sat_count = sat_cells[cell_id]
341	                satellite_mean = sat_total / sat_count
342	                diff = station_mean - satellite_mean
343	                results.append(
344	                    (
345	                        bucket,
346	                        cell_id,
347	                        _quantize3(station_mean),
348	                        _quantize3(satellite_mean),
349	                        _quantize3(diff),
350	                    )
351	                )
352	    return results
353	
354	
355	def _validate_aligned_row(row: object) -> tuple[int, str, float, float, float]:
356	    """Validate one ``align_temp`` ``(t, c, s, l, d)`` five-tuple."""
357	    if not isinstance(row, tuple) or len(row) != 5:
358	        raise ValueError(
359	            "each aligned row must be an align_temp "
360	            "(timestamp, cell_id, station_c, satellite_c, diff_c) five-tuple"
361	        )
362	    timestamp, cell_id, station, satellite, diff = row
363	    _validate_timestamp(timestamp)
364	    if not isinstance(cell_id, str) or not cell_id:
365	        raise ValueError("cell_id must be a non-empty string")
366	    _validate_temperature(station, "station_c")
367	    _validate_temperature(satellite, "satellite_c")
368	    _validate_temperature(diff, "diff_c")
369	    return timestamp, cell_id, station, satellite, diff
370	
371	
372	def _validate_grid_number(value: object, name: str, *, positive: bool) -> Decimal:
373	    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)):
374	        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a finite int or float")
375	    if not math.isfinite(value):
376	        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be finite")
377	    decimal_value = Decimal(str(value))
378	    if positive:
379	        if decimal_value <= 0:
380	            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be greater than 0")
381	    elif decimal_value < 0:
382	        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be non-negative")
383	    return decimal_value
384	
385	
386	def _validate_grid_item(item: object) -> tuple[str, str, Decimal, Decimal, Decimal]:
387	    if not isinstance(item, tuple) or len(item) != 5:
388	        raise ValueError(
389	            "each item must be a (cell_id, kind, height, area, grid_area) tuple"
390	        )
391	    cell_id, kind, height, area, grid_area = item
392	    if not isinstance(cell_id, str) or not cell_id:
393	        raise ValueError("cell_id must be a non-empty string")
394	    _check_hashable(kind, "kind")
395	    if kind not in _ITEM_KINDS:
396	        raise ValueError(
397	            "kind must be one of 'building', 'impervious', 'green' or 'other'"
398	        )

400	    area_d = _validate_grid_number(area, "area", positive=False)
401	    grid_area_d = _validate_grid_number(grid_area, "grid_area", positive=True)

407	def _grid_precision(decimals: list[Decimal]) -> int:
408	    """Precision wide enough for exact sums/products and guarded division,
409	    independent of the default decimal context."""
410	    max_adj = 0
411	    min_exp = 0
412	    n = 0
413	    for value in decimals:
414	        n += 1
415	        if not value.is_zero():
416	            max_adj = max(max_adj, value.adjusted())
417	            min_exp = min(min_exp, value.as_tuple().exponent)
418	    span = max_adj - min_exp + 1
419	    # products join two spans; summing n values adds log10(n) digits; keep a
420	    # guard margin for division and the 4-decimal quantization.
421	    return 2 * span + 5 * len(str(max(n, 1))) + 20
422

425	    result = float(value.quantize(_QUANT4, rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN))
426	    return 0.0 if result == 0.0 else result

429	def grid_features(
430	    aligned: list, items: list
431	) -> list[tuple[int, object, float, float, float, float, float, float, float]]:
432	    """Attach grid-geometry features to aligned temperature rows.
433	
434	    ``aligned`` is a list of ``align_temp`` five-tuples
435	    ``(timestamp, cell_id, station_c, satellite_c, diff_c)``. ``items`` is a
436	    list of ``(cell_id, kind, height, area, grid_area)`` tuples, where kind is
437	    ``building``, ``impervious``, ``green`` or ``other``. Heights and areas are
438	    non-negative finite numbers (booleans rejected); ``grid_area`` must be
439	    positive; non-building items must have height 0. All items sharing a
440	    cell_id must have the same grid area (compared via ``Decimal(str(x))``);
441	    per cell, both the total building area and the total non-building area
442	    must not exceed the grid area.
443	
444	    Non-building kinds are coverage items (zero-area items still count as
445	    present). A grid cell is kept only when it has at least one building
446	    item, at least one coverage item and the coverage area equals the grid
447	    area. For each kept cell referenced by an aligned row, four features are
448	    appended: the area-weighted mean building height
449	    ``sum(h*a)/sum(a)`` (0 when the total building area is 0), and the
450	    building, impervious and green area fractions (each sum divided by the
451	    grid area). All sums, products, comparisons and division use
452	    ``Decimal(str(x))`` under a raised-precision local context; features are
453	    quantized to 4 decimals (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) and returned as floats, with
454	    negative zero normalized to ``0.0``. Rows are sorted by timestamp then
455	    cell_id.
456	    """
457	    if not isinstance(aligned, list):
458	        raise TypeError("aligned must be a list")
459	    if not isinstance(items, list):
460	        raise TypeError("items must be a list")
461	    aligned_rows = [_validate_aligned_row(row) for row in aligned]
462	
463	    parsed = [_validate_grid_item(item) for item in items]
464	
465	    precision_inputs: list[Decimal] = []
466	    for _, _, height, area, grid_area in parsed:
467	        precision_inputs.extend((height, area, grid_area))
468	
469	    zero = Decimal(0)
470	    with localcontext() as ctx:
471	        ctx.prec = _grid_precision(precision_inputs)
472	        # cell_id -> {"g", "buildings": [(h, a)], "b_area", "cov_area",
473	        #              "imp_area", "green_area", "n_build", "n_cov"}
474	        cells: dict[str, dict] = {}
475	        for cell_id, kind, height, area, grid_area in parsed:
476	            entry = cells.get(cell_id)
477	            if entry is None:
478	                entry = {
479	                    "g": grid_area,
480	                    "buildings": [],
481	                    "b_area": zero,
482	                    "cov_area": zero,
483	                    "imp_area": zero,
484	                    "green_area": zero,
485	                    "n_build": 0,
486	                    "n_cov": 0,
487	                }
488	                cells[cell_id] = entry
489	            elif entry["g"] != grid_area:
490	                raise ValueError(
491	                    f"grid_area for cell {cell_id!r} must be consistent across items"
492	                )
493	            if kind == "building":
494	                entry["n_build"] += 1
495	                entry["b_area"] += area
496	                entry["buildings"].append((height, area))
497	            else:
498	                entry["n_cov"] += 1
499	                entry["cov_area"] += area
500	                if kind == "impervious":
501	                    entry["imp_area"] += area
502	                elif kind == "green":
503	                    entry["green_area"] += area
504	
505	        for cell_id, entry in cells.items():
506	            if entry["b_area"] > entry["g"]:
507	                raise ValueError(
508	                    f"total building area for cell {cell_id!r} exceeds grid_area"
509	                )
510	            if entry["cov_area"] > entry["g"]:
511	                raise ValueError(
512	                    f"total non-building area for cell {cell_id!r} exceeds grid_area"
513	                )
514	
515	        features: dict[str, tuple[float, float, float, float]] = {}
516	        for cell_id, entry in cells.items():
517	            if entry["n_build"] < 1 or entry["n_cov"] < 1:
518	                continue
519	            if entry["cov_area"] != entry["g"]:
520	                continue
521	            grid_area = entry["g"]
522	            building_area = entry["b_area"]
523	            if building_area == 0:
524	                mean_height = zero
525	            else:
526	                weighted = zero
527	                for height, area in entry["buildings"]:
528	                    weighted += height * area
529	                mean_height = weighted / building_area
530	            features[cell_id] = (
531	                _quantize4(mean_height),
532	                _quantize4(building_area / grid_area),
533	                _quantize4(entry["imp_area"] / grid_area),
534	                _quantize4(entry["green_area"] / grid_area),
535	            )
536	
537	    results = []
538	    for row in aligned_rows:
539	        cell_features = features.get(row[1])
540	        if cell_features is None:
541	            continue
542	        results.append(
543	            (
544	                row[0],
545	                row[1],
546	                row[2],
547	                row[3],
548	                row[4],
549	                cell_features[0],
550	                cell_features[1],
551	                cell_features[2],
552	                cell_features[3],
553	            )
554	        )
555	    results.sort(key=lambda row: (row[0], row[1]))
556	    return results

611	) -> list[tuple[int, str, Decimal, Decimal, Decimal, Decimal, Decimal]]:
612	    """Validate the non-empty rows contract shared by model fitting and scenarios."""
613	    if not isinstance(rows, list):
614	        raise TypeError("rows must be a list")
615	    if not rows:
616	        raise ValueError("rows must not be empty")
617	    parsed: list[tuple[int, str, Decimal, Decimal, Decimal, Decimal, Decimal]] = []
618	    seen: set[tuple[int, str]] = set()
619	    for row in rows:
620	        timestamp, cell_id, height_d, build_d, imp_d, green_d, diff_d = (

632	def fit_uhi_model(
633	    rows: list,
634	) -> tuple[int, float, float, float, float, float, float]:
635	    """Fit a ridge-regression model of the temperature difference on grid features.
636	
637	    ``rows`` is a non-empty list of nine-tuples
638	    ``(timestamp, cell_id, station_c, satellite_c, d, h, b, i, g)`` where the
639	    first five fields follow the ``align_temp`` row contract, ``h`` (mean
640	    building height) is a non-negative finite number and ``b``/``i``/``g``
641	    (building, impervious and green area fractions) are finite numbers in
642	    ``[0, 1]``; booleans are rejected everywhere. ``(timestamp, cell_id)``
643	    pairs must be unique.
644	
645	    The target is ``d`` and the features are ``h``, ``b``, ``i`` and ``g``,
646	    with an intercept. Rows are processed in ascending ``(timestamp,
647	    cell_id)`` order. Every number enters the computation as
648	    ``Decimal(str(x))``; the ridge normal equations are assembled and solved
649	    under a precision-1000, ROUND_HALF_EVEN local context. The penalty
650	    ``0.000001`` is added to the four feature diagonal entries (not the
651	    intercept's) and the system is solved by Gauss-Jordan elimination, each
652	    pivot chosen as the largest absolute value in the remaining rows, ties
653	    keeping the earliest row; a zero pivot raises ``ValueError``.
654	
655	    Returns ``(n, b0, bh, bb, bi, bg, r2)``: the sample count, intercept,
656	    feature coefficients and ``1 - SSE/SST`` with
657	    ``SST = sum((d - mean(d)) ** 2)`` (``r2`` is 0 when ``SST`` is 0). The
658	    final six values are quantized to 6 decimals (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) and
659	    returned as floats, with negative zero normalized to ``0.0``.
660	    """
661	    parsed = _parse_feature_rows(rows)
662	    n = len(parsed)
663	
664	    with localcontext() as ctx:
665	        ctx.prec = _MODEL_PRECISION
666	        ctx.rounding = ROUND_HALF_EVEN
667	
668	        zero = Decimal(0)
669	        one = Decimal(1)
670	        # Columns: 0 = intercept, 1..4 = h, b, i, g.
671	        size = _MODEL_FEATURES + 1
672	        xtx = [[zero] * size for _ in range(size)]
673	        xty = [zero] * size
674	        for _, _, height, build, imp, green, diff in parsed:
675	            features = (one, height, build, imp, green)
676	            for j in range(size):
677	                xty[j] += features[j] * diff
678	                for k in range(j, size):
679	                    xtx[j][k] += features[j] * features[k]
680	        for j in range(size):
681	            for k in range(j):
682	                xtx[j][k] = xtx[k][j]
683	        for j in range(1, size):
684	            xtx[j][j] += _RIDGE_PENALTY
685	
686	        # Augmented matrix for Gauss-Jordan elimination.
687	        matrix = [xtx[row_idx] + [xty[row_idx]] for row_idx in range(size)]
688	        for col in range(size):
689	            pivot = col
690	            pivot_magnitude = abs(matrix[col][col])
691	            for row_idx in range(col + 1, size):
692	                magnitude = abs(matrix[row_idx][col])
693	                if magnitude > pivot_magnitude:
694	                    pivot_magnitude = magnitude
695	                    pivot = row_idx
696	            if pivot_magnitude == 0:
697	                raise ValueError("singular design matrix: zero pivot in normal equations")
698	            if pivot != col:
699	                matrix[col], matrix[pivot] = matrix[pivot], matrix[col]
700	            pivot_value = matrix[col][col]
701	            for k in range(col, size + 1):
702	                matrix[col][k] /= pivot_value
703	            for row_idx in range(size):
704	                if row_idx == col:
705	                    continue
706	                factor = matrix[row_idx][col]
707	                if factor == 0:
708	                    continue
709	                for k in range(col, size + 1):
710	                    matrix[row_idx][k] -= factor * matrix[col][k]
711	
712	        beta = [matrix[row_idx][size] for row_idx in range(size)]
713	
714	        diff_sum = zero
715	        for _, _, _, _, _, _, diff in parsed:
716	            diff_sum += diff
717	        diff_mean = diff_sum / n
718	
719	        sst = zero
720	        sse = zero
721	        for _, _, height, build, imp, green, diff in parsed:
722	            residual = diff - (
723	                beta[0]
724	                + beta[1] * height
725	                + beta[2] * build
726	                + beta[3] * imp
727	                + beta[4] * green
728	            )
729	            sse += residual * residual
730	            deviation = diff - diff_mean
731	            sst += deviation * deviation
732	        r2 = zero if sst == 0 else one - sse / sst
733	
734	        return (
735	            n,
736	            _quantize6(beta[0]),
737	            _quantize6(beta[1]),
738	            _quantize6(beta[2]),
739	            _quantize6(beta[3]),
740	            _quantize6(beta[4]),
741	            _quantize6(r2),
742	        )
743

748	    if not math.isfinite(value):
749	        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be finite")

753	def scenario(
754	    model: tuple,
755	    rows: list,
756	    actions: list,
757	    *,
758	    roof_c: float = 0.0,
759	    material_c: float = 0.0,
760	) -> tuple[list[tuple], tuple[int, float, float, float]]:
761	    """Apply green-space, cool-roof and cool-material actions to fitted rows.
762	
763	    ``model`` is a ``fit_uhi_model`` return value
764	    ``(n, b0, bh, bb, bi, bg, r2)`` and ``rows`` follows the same non-empty
765	    ``(timestamp, cell_id, station_c, satellite_c, d, h, b, i, g)`` contract
766	    as ``fit_uhi_model`` (unique ``(timestamp, cell_id)`` pairs). ``actions``
767	    is a list of ``(c, G, R, M)`` tuples: ``c`` is a cell id that must be
768	    unique within ``actions`` and occur in ``rows``; ``G`` (green), ``R``
769	    (roof) and ``M`` (material) are finite non-boolean numbers in ``[0, 1]``.
770	    For every row sharing a listed cell, ``G + M <= i`` and ``R <= b`` must
771	    hold; unlisted cells get ``G = R = M = 0``. ``roof_c`` and
772	    ``material_c`` are non-negative finite non-boolean cost coefficients
773	    (keyword-only, default ``0.0``).
774	
775	    For each row, ``base = b0 + bh*h + bb*b + bi*i + bg*g``,
776	    ``cg = (bg - bi) * G``, ``cr = -roof_c * R``, ``cm = -material_c * M``,
777	    ``post = base + cg + cr + cm`` and ``delta = post - base``. All numbers
778	    enter as ``Decimal(str(x))`` under a precision-1000, ROUND_HALF_EVEN
779	    local context.
780	
781	    Returns ``(details, summary)``: ``details`` lists
782	    ``(timestamp, cell_id, base, post, delta, cg, cr, cm)`` tuples in
783	    ascending ``(timestamp, cell_id)`` order, with the six numeric fields
784	    quantized to 6 decimals (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) as floats, negative zero
785	    normalized to ``0.0``; ``summary`` is
786	    ``(count, base_mean, post_mean, delta_mean)`` with the means computed
787	    from the unquantized per-row values before 6-decimal quantization.
788	    ``rows`` or ``actions`` not being a list raises ``TypeError``; every
789	    other contract violation raises ``ValueError``.
790	    """
791	    if not isinstance(rows, list):
792	        raise TypeError("rows must be a list")
793	    if not isinstance(actions, list):
794	        raise TypeError("actions must be a list")
795	
796	    parsed = _parse_feature_rows(rows)
797	
798	    if not isinstance(model, tuple) or len(model) != 7:
799	        raise ValueError(
800	            "model must be a fit_uhi_model (n, b0, bh, bb, bi, bg, r2) seven-tuple"
801	        )
802	    model_n, b0_v, bh_v, bb_v, bi_v, bg_v, r2_v = model
803	    if isinstance(model_n, bool) or not isinstance(model_n, int) or model_n < 1:
804	        raise ValueError("model n must be a positive integer")
805	    b0 = _validate_finite_number(b0_v, "b0")
806	    bh = _validate_finite_number(bh_v, "bh")
807	    bb = _validate_finite_number(bb_v, "bb")
808	    bi = _validate_finite_number(bi_v, "bi")
809	    bg = _validate_finite_number(bg_v, "bg")
810	    _validate_finite_number(r2_v, "r2")
811	
812	    roof_cost = _validate_grid_number(roof_c, "roof_c", positive=False)
813	    material_cost = _validate_grid_number(material_c, "material_c", positive=False)
814	
815	    zero = Decimal(0)
816	    one = Decimal(1)
817	    cell_ids = {cell_id for _, cell_id, *_ in parsed}
818	    action_map: dict[str, tuple[Decimal, Decimal, Decimal]] = {}
819	    for item in actions:
820	        if not isinstance(item, tuple) or len(item) != 4:
821	            raise ValueError("each action must be a (c, G, R, M) four-tuple")
822	        cell_id, green_v, roof_v, material_v = item
823	        _check_hashable(cell_id, "c")
824	        if cell_id not in cell_ids:
825	            raise ValueError(f"unknown cell id in action: {cell_id!r}")
826	        if cell_id in action_map:
827	            raise ValueError(f"duplicate action cell id: {cell_id!r}")
828	        green = _validate_model_number(green_v, "G", low=zero, high=one)
829	        roof = _validate_model_number(roof_v, "R", low=zero, high=one)
830	        material = _validate_model_number(material_v, "M", low=zero, high=one)
831	        action_map[cell_id] = (green, roof, material)
832	
833	    with localcontext() as ctx:
834	        ctx.prec = _MODEL_PRECISION
835	        ctx.rounding = ROUND_HALF_EVEN
836	
837	        details = []
838	        base_sum = zero
839	        post_sum = zero
840	        delta_sum = zero
841	        for timestamp, cell_id, height, build, imp, green_frac, _d in parsed:
842	            green, roof, material = action_map.get(cell_id, (zero, zero, zero))
843	            if cell_id in action_map and (green + material > imp or roof > build):
844	                raise ValueError(
845	                    f"action for cell {cell_id!r} exceeds available area: "
846	                    "G + M must be <= i and R must be <= b"
847	                )
848	            base = b0 + bh * height + bb * build + bi * imp + bg * green_frac
849	            cg = (bg - bi) * green
850	            cr = -roof_cost * roof
851	            cm = -material_cost * material
852	            post = base + cg + cr + cm
853	            delta = post - base
854	
855	            base_sum += base
856	            post_sum += post
857	            delta_sum += delta
858	            details.append(
859	                (
860	                    timestamp,
861	                    cell_id,
862	                    _quantize6(base),
863	                    _quantize6(post),
864	                    _quantize6(delta),
865	                    _quantize6(cg),
866	                    _quantize6(cr),
867	                    _quantize6(cm),
868	                )
869	            )
870	
871	        count = len(details)
872	        summary = (
873	            count,
874	            _quantize6(base_sum / count),
875	            _quantize6(post_sum / count),
876	            _quantize6(delta_sum / count),
877	        )
878	    return details, summary

905	    details: list,
906	    *,
907	    by: str,
908	    minutes: int = 60,
